_about: The deck for n8n_whatsapp_ionly.py (29 Oct, evening): one voice, Michael's. The owner's own chat on the live bot (29 Oct 17:02-17:06 UTC, executions 138669 and 138681) word for word, and five short cases the changed texts touch: a manager request, a claimed payment, a document only a person can produce, 'are you a bot?' then a person, and someone stuck in the lift. Every resident is invented except the owner's test persona; only בר כוכבא 23 is used, and nothing here writes anywhere. TEAM in the expectations is every way a reply puts someone other than Michael on the matter, or speaks as 'we' who will act. `expect` is never shown to the players.
